planets.name: TOI-700 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-700 with a 16.1-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-700 c was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-700. Its orbit and size follow Pass et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
